Hi Emma — thanks for flagging and for the screenshot, that helps.

Short answer: the session is confirmed for 10:00 Singapore Time (Asia/Singapore, GMT+8). The mismatch you see is because our Calendly page defaulted to the browser-detected locale for the org (weird combo of EU display labels + localized offsets). Some calendar clients render the timezone label differently (e.g., "SGT" vs "UTC+08:00") which can look like an hour off.

Two quick workarounds that usually fix this immediately:
- Open the Calendly confirmation page and use the Time Zone dropdown at the top-right of the scheduling widget to force "Asia/Singapore" (this re-generates the invite in the right zone).
- If you already downloaded the .ics, open the invite in your calendar and check the event timezone settings; change the event timezone to "Asia/Singapore (GMT+8)" before saving.

If you prefer, I can send a manual invite from my calendar specifying SGT so it's unambiguous — I do that for some APAC enterprise customers to avoid DST/localization issues.

I'll attach the demo agenda now. If you're ok with me sending the manual invite, let me know the email you want it sent to (I can send to the address you used).

Best,
